title: Multi-Provider Schedule + Content → Booking
summary: Portfolio demo: content feed and provider profiles funnel into bookable slots — multi-provider time conflict handled in one H5 shell (compliance-friendly showcase narrative).
problem: Marketplaces and creator-led services need discovery (feed or profile) tied to real availability. A single Calendly link per person does not show multi-provider scheduling or a content-to-booking funnel in one demo.
solution:
Self-built portfolio demo (not a client delivery). smart.a H5 combines a content-oriented surface with per-provider bookable windows and order flow — the same backend ideas as bz.a, extended to a people × time matrix. Useful for tutoring packs, multi-stylist salons, or any multi-provider schedule story without claiming a specific live client.

Demo screenshots are template UI only; no fabricated client names or metrics.

zh.title: 多服务者排期 + 内容 → 预约
zh.summary: 作品集演示：内容流与服务者主页导向可订时段，同一 H5 壳内处理多服务者时间冲突（合规对外叙事，非敏感行业表述）。
zh.problem: 平台型或创作者带单的业务需要「被发现」和「可订档」连在一起。每人一个 Calendly 链接无法在一个 demo 里展示多服务者排期与内容到下单的漏斗。
zh.solution:
自建作品集演示（非客户交付）。smart.a H5 把偏内容的浏览面与各服务者可订窗口、下单流程接在一起——与 bz.a 同源思路，扩展到人×时间矩阵。适合私教课包、多技师沙龙等叙事，不虚构具体客户或数据。

截图为模板 UI，非真实客户品牌。
